claims.claim: Used Nikon D610 in good condition
claims.evidence: Photos 0 and 1 clearly show 'Nikon D810' text on the body, not D610 — model claim does not match the photographed item.

claims.claim: May show sign of cosmetic wears
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows surface wear/scuffing on the top plate and dusty hot shoe contacts, consistent with cosmetic wear.
No battery, charger, or accessory box/photo shown in the report; statement is incomplete and cannot be checked from images.

risks.risk: Model mismatch between seller's words (D610) and witness-identified body (D810) could indicate seller confusion, a copy-pasted listing, or deliberate misrepresentation.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit photo of the camera's nameplate/model badge and serial number sticker, cross-checked against seller's claim.
risks.if_unproven: Price strictly as the witness-identified D810 body, ignoring the seller's D610 claim; treat the discrepancy as a trust flag.

risks.risk: Unknown shutter actuation count affects remaining mechanical life and value.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a diagnostic app or EXIF data of a fresh test shot.

risks.risk: Sensor condition (dust, scratches, calibration) cannot be seen in body-only photos.
risks.proof: A photo taken through the lens mount with mirror up, or a test image showing sensor dust spots against a plain white background.

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and other accessories' inclusion is unclear and unverifiable from photos.
risks.proof: A single photo showing the camera with battery, charger, and any included cables/lens laid out together.

risks.risk: Memory card slot functionality not shown.
risks.proof: A video/photo of a card being inserted and recognized on the camera's screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified/possibly faulty card slot.

risks.risk: Overall functional test (autofocus, dials, buttons, LCD) not demonstrated.
risks.proof: A short video powering on the camera, cycling through menus, and firing the shutter with a lens attached.

risks.risk: Possible internal fungus or electronic faults not visible externally.
risks.proof: A close-up photo through the mount/viewfinder under strong light showing the mirror and focusing screen clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unverified internal risk, treated conservatively.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model nameplate and serial number to resolve D610 vs D810 discrepancy
Photo of shutter count from a diagnostic tool or test shot EXIF data
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, cables, lens if any) laid out together
Short video showing camera powering on, menu navigation, and shutter firing
Close-up photo through the lens mount showing mirror/sensor area for dust or fungus
response.reason: The witness positively identifies the body as a Nikon D810, contradicting the seller's claim of a D610, so it must be priced at worst case as the photographed D810 with unresolved cosmetic wear, missing accessories, and unverified internal/functional condition.
